stayType: Self-catering cottages and touring caravan sites
accommodation: Four cottages: The Anchorage (sleeps 6), Manor Farm Cottage (sleeps 6), Thatch Cottage (sleeps 4), The Reeds in Croyde (sleeps 6); plus two touring caravan sites (no tents)
suitableFor: Families and small groups, touring caravanners
parking: Free parking at Putsborough Sands car park for cottage guests
beachAccess: The Anchorage about 10 minutes' walk by private footpath; Manor Farm Cottage half a mile; Putsborough Sands Caravan Park is at the beach
boardStorage: Cold freshwater showers on the beach (motorhome area)
confirmedFeatures: Private or secluded gardens, beach shop and café, toilets, two touring caravan sites, motorhome overnight area with water and Elsan point
overview: Putsborough runs four holiday cottages and two touring caravan sites around Putsborough Sands, at the southern end of the three-mile beach to Woolacombe, with one cottage in Croyde. The cottages are between ten minutes' walk and half a mile from the sand, and guests get free parking at the beach car park.
surfTripFit: Close to Putsborough Sands with free beach parking, which suits surfers looking to check the sheltered southern corner of Woolacombe Bay.
gaps: Name 'Putsborough Manor Holiday Cottages' not used by sources; matched to Putsborough cottages (Manor Farm Cottage). Dog policy and opening dates not stated.
